'''Bombardier''' was a role within military organizations, usually tasked with the release of explosive weapons such as [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedos]] from vehicles. A bombardier was utilized aboard the [[Vindicator (light freighter)|''Vindicator'']], a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] as a torpedo [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]].
